QuestInfo.name: Repairing the Book
QuestInfo.0: #b#p502##k asked me to speak with him again about the ledger.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p502##k thought #b#p602##k in #b#m010005000##k might be able to repair the pages.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p602##k agreed to work on the ledger. He asked me to come back once he'd made a start.

0.0: Those pages need more than memories. They need someone that can repair them.
0.1: There's a man in #b#m010005000##k who mends things that shouldn't be mendable. #b#p602##k. Do you want the introduction or not?

yes.0: I'll send the pages down separately. They'll be there before you are.

no.0: I knew you'd end up wasting my time.

1.0: #b#p502##k sent you? Hm. He asks for so little that I'm obliged to help.
1.1: I have rebound worse. What I cannot promise I'll be able to fix is the long entry.\nThere is a record running the whole length of this book, front to back, and whoever wrote it kept coming back to it for years. That is the one the rain went after.
1.2: Well, we'll just have to see what happens!

npc.0: Stop bothering me. I told you the pages will be there before you are.
